tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Desktop behind every window: the orkspace's ground. Camp: the biome's soil (forest/ice/void from theme.py). Office: Sublime's sidebar black.

tokens.name: terrain
tokens.usage: Terrain marks scattered on `canvas` (camp only; ≤12% of the surface). Decorative, never text. Office has no terrain: equals `canvas`.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Window and building interior, menus, cards. The main ground for `ink`, `ink-muted` and every signal text.

tokens.name: panel-inset
tokens.usage: Sunken wells inside a panel: inputs, logs, terminals, the War Map list. Camp: a dark recess under `bevel-sunken`; Office: the editor gutter tone.

tokens.name: panel-raised
tokens.usage: Raised faces: buttons, tabs, title bars, the HUD strip. Text on it is `ink` or `ink-gold` only.

tokens.name: bevel-hi
tokens.usage: Lit edge of a camp bevel (top/left); in Office a 1px hairline. Used only inside the `bevel-*` shadows.

tokens.name: bevel-lo
tokens.usage: Shadowed edge of a camp bevel (bottom/right) and the 2px outer keyline of camp windows.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Selected row in lists, the War Map and menus. Text on it is `ink` only.

tokens.name: frame
tokens.usage: Inactive window and building frame. Forest: muted bronze gold (theme.py had moss green #3e6b48); ice and void keep theme.py `border`; Office: a warm brown hairline. Decorative separator: below 3:1 on purpose, never the only cue.

tokens.name: hut-frame
tokens.usage: The frame of a hut on the town map. Camp: frame. Office: ≈3:1 on canvas, so a block keeps its box in a diagram (frame alone is a decorative hairline).

tokens.name: frame-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders: inputs, checkboxes, unfocused buttons in Office. ≥3:1 on `panel`.

tokens.name: frame-focus
tokens.usage: Focused window frame and the focus ring of every control. Forest: bright gold, a step above the bronze `frame` (theme.py had #c99a3e); ice: #82aaff; Office: Camp gold, the same as forest. ≥3:1 on all grounds.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and building names (hut.py HEAD_STYLE, parchment in Camp; a warm parchment white in Office). On every ground.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Live status lines, secondary labels, hints (hut.py LIVE_STYLE). On `panel`, `panel-inset`, `canvas`.

tokens.name: ink-comment
tokens.usage: Disabled text, placeholder decoration, terrain-level hints (a warm grey in Office). Below 4.5:1 by design: never for content someone must read.

tokens.name: ink-gold
tokens.usage: Camp's voice: button labels, building actions, window titles, HUD numbers (hut.py BUTTON_STYLE). Office: the same Camp gold for the same roles.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Fill of the one primary button in a dialog (Draft, Build, Send). Camp: Factorio-style confirm green; Office: the same moss green, a little brighter.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label on `action`.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: A question waiting — the first fire stage (hut.py FIRE[0]). Office: the same orange. Text on `panel`/`canvas`; frames and badges anywhere.

tokens.name: alert-hot
tokens.usage: Left waiting past 30 s — the red stage (FIRE[1]); Office: the red frame of a waiting building. Fills, frames and icons only (≥3:1), not body text.

tokens.name: fire-glow
tokens.usage: Flicker partner of `alert` (FIRE[2]). Camp animation only.

tokens.name: fire-ember
tokens.usage: Flicker partner of `alert-hot` (FIRE[3]). Camp animation only.

tokens.name: fire-ground
tokens.usage: Ground under a building in the orange stage (FIRE_GROUND[0]). `ink` reads on it.

tokens.name: fire-ground-hot
tokens.usage: Ground under a building in the red stage (FIRE_GROUND[1]). `ink` reads on it.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Passed checks, ✓ rows, diff additions (theme.py DIFF_ADD). Always paired with ✓ or a word.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failures, ✗ rows, diff removals, destructive buttons (DIFF_REMOVE). Always paired with ✗ or a word.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Held carts, ⚠ notes (carts.py held).

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Links, info marks, the ice biome's accent.

tokens.name: unit-active
tokens.usage: An ork at work (theme.py UNIT_ACTIVE).

tokens.name: unit-alert
tokens.usage: An ork in trouble (theme.py UNIT_ALERT).

tokens.name: harness-claude
tokens.usage: ✻ Claude in harness schemes (looks.py). Same hue in Camp; the same amber in Office.

tokens.name: harness-agy
tokens.usage: ✦ agy in harness schemes. Lightened from #3b82f6 so it reads on dark panels.

tokens.name: harness-codex
tokens.usage: ⌬ Codex in harness schemes.

tokens.name: harness-hermes
tokens.usage: ☤ Hermes Agent in harness schemes.

tokens.name: harness-pi
tokens.usage: π pi in harness schemes.

tokens.name: harness-cursor
tokens.usage: ◆ Cursor in harness schemes.

tokens.name: harness-pipeline
tokens.usage: P pipelines in harness schemes; Office: a soft orchid.

tokens.name: day
tokens.usage: Day bar: waking hours (day_bar.py DAY_COLOR).

tokens.name: day-quiet
tokens.usage: Day bar: 🌙 quiet hours (QUIET_COLOR). Fill only.

tokens.name: day-office
tokens.usage: Day bar: office hours in Shift (OFFICE_COLOR). Fill only.

tokens.name: quiet-ink
tokens.usage: HUD text for quiet hours (hud.py). On `panel-raised` in Camp, `panel` in Office.

tokens.name: road
tokens.usage: Faint road between buildings (road_layer.py ROAD_FAINT, dirt brown in Camp). Office: a plain link (no handler), drawn dashed; #8f8166 is ≈4.6:1 on canvas so a block diagram reads.

tokens.name: road-bright
tokens.usage: Roads of the selected building (ROAD_BRIGHT).

tokens.name: road-selected
tokens.usage: The selected road and its label chip (ROAD_SELECTED); label text on it is `on-action`.

tokens.name: road-live
tokens.usage: A road with a handler: work happens on it. Camp: the same dirt as road. Office: moss green (action), solid, ≈6:1 on canvas.

tokens.name: tier-elder
tokens.usage: 🔮 elder tier (tiers.py). Text on `panel`.

tokens.name: tier-warrior
tokens.usage: ⚔ warrior tier. Text on `panel`.

tokens.name: tier-laborer
tokens.usage: ⛏ laborer tier. Text on `panel`.

tokens.name: cart-filtered
tokens.usage: A cart a road filtered out (carts.py).

tokens.name: cart-held
tokens.usage: A held cart: Camp fills the rock with it; Office colours the ■.

tokens.name: cart-error
tokens.usage: A cart that failed: Camp rock fill; Office ■ colour.

tokens.name: sticky-yellow
tokens.usage: Fill of a yellow card on the Task Fields board (tasks_view.py COLOR_STYLE 🟨). Camp paints the whole card with it; Office keeps cards on `panel` and uses `mark-yellow`. `ink` and `ink-muted` read on it.

tokens.name: sticky-green
tokens.usage: Fill of a green card on the Task Fields board (tasks_view.py COLOR_STYLE 🟩). Camp paints the whole card with it; Office keeps cards on `panel` and uses `mark-green`. `ink` and `ink-muted` read on it.

tokens.name: sticky-blue
tokens.usage: Fill of a blue card on the Task Fields board (tasks_view.py COLOR_STYLE 🟦). Camp paints the whole card with it; Office keeps cards on `panel` and uses `mark-blue`. `ink` and `ink-muted` read on it.

tokens.name: sticky-red
tokens.usage: Fill of a red card on the Task Fields board (tasks_view.py COLOR_STYLE 🟥). Camp paints the whole card with it; Office keeps cards on `panel` and uses `mark-red`. `ink` and `ink-muted` read on it.

tokens.name: sticky-purple
tokens.usage: Fill of a purple card on the Task Fields board (tasks_view.py COLOR_STYLE 🟪). Camp paints the whole card with it; Office keeps cards on `panel` and uses `mark-purple`. `ink` and `ink-muted` read on it.

tokens.name: mark-yellow
tokens.usage: The yellow colour square before a card title (🟨 in the board file). Office shows it on every coloured card; Camp only in the colour picker. A mark, ≥3:1 on `panel`.

tokens.name: mark-green
tokens.usage: The green colour square before a card title (🟩 in the board file). Office shows it on every coloured card; Camp only in the colour picker. A mark, ≥3:1 on `panel`.

tokens.name: mark-blue
tokens.usage: The blue colour square before a card title (🟦 in the board file). Office shows it on every coloured card; Camp only in the colour picker. A mark, ≥3:1 on `panel`.

tokens.name: mark-red
tokens.usage: The red colour square before a card title (🟥 in the board file). Office shows it on every coloured card; Camp only in the colour picker. A mark, ≥3:1 on `panel`.

tokens.name: mark-purple
tokens.usage: The purple colour square before a card title (🟪 in the board file). Office shows it on every coloured card; Camp only in the colour picker. A mark, ≥3:1 on `panel`.

tokens.name: pr-merged
tokens.usage: A merged pull request in the Forge (git_view.py magenta). An open PR is `success`, a closed one `danger`, a draft `ink-muted`. Text on `panel` and `panel-inset`.

tokens.name: meter
tokens.usage: Fill of meters (bars.py COLOR in Camp; the same tan gold in Office, kept apart from the brighter `warning` yellow).

styles.name: camp-title
styles.usage: Dialog and screen titles, the War Map header. ink-gold.

styles.name: camp-heading
styles.usage: Window titles and building names on the map.

styles.name: camp-label
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels and buttons (Factorio panel headers).

styles.name: camp-body
styles.sample: Agents never pop dialogs: when one needs you it sets its hut on fire.
styles.usage: Running text in panels and dialogs.

styles.name: camp-caption
styles.usage: Building status lines, hints, footers. ink-muted.

styles.name: camp-number
styles.usage: HUD resources and counters, with tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums).

styles.name: office-heading
styles.usage: Uppercase sidebar and panel headers (VS Code section header).

styles.name: office-body
styles.sample: Requests from mail become tasks; agents draft what they can.

styles.name: office-caption
styles.usage: Status bar, hints, status lines. ink-muted.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Terminals, diffs, logs and code only. Never chrome: labels, keys, inputs and numbers use the look's UI face.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap; office list row padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Control padding (office), gaps between buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding (camp), panel padding (office).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding (camp), dialog padding (office).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Dialog padding (camp), gap between huts on the map.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section gaps in dialogs; the grid step of the town map.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Every camp surface: windows, buttons, inputs, huts. Camp is square like its sprites.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Office buttons, inputs, badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Office menus, toasts, cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Office dialogs and windows.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Office meters, the day bar, chips and road labels: fully rounded ends.

tokens.name: border-hair
tokens.usage: Office frames and every office control border.

tokens.name: border-bevel
tokens.usage: Camp bevels and the camp focus ring.

tokens.name: border-frame
tokens.usage: Camp window frame (frame / frame-focus), the burning building outline.

tokens.name: control-camp
tokens.usage: Camp buttons, inputs, tabs.

tokens.name: control-office
tokens.usage: Office buttons, inputs, tabs.

tokens.name: bar-hud
tokens.usage: HUD strip on top, key footer at the bottom (both modes).

tokens.name: titlebar
tokens.usage: Camp window title bar (Office uses a 35px editor tab bar).

tokens.name: tile
tokens.usage: Camp map ground tile. Header and banner sprites sit on a 16px grid (half a tile).

tokens.name: header-xs
tokens.usage: Hut width for catalog size XS (Pit, Mill, Horn). Its building sprite is 64×32 (2:1), centred on the card's top edge.

tokens.name: header-s
tokens.usage: Hut width for size S (Signpost, Scroll Dump, Loot Vault, Catapult, Workshop, Custom); building sprite 80×40.

tokens.name: header-m
tokens.usage: Hut width for size M (Watchtower, Task Fields, Barracks, Clan Fire, Forge, Tally Crag); building sprite 96×48.

tokens.name: header-l
tokens.usage: Hut width for size L (War Drum, File Forest, Town Hall, Lake); building sprite 112×56.

tokens.name: banner-w
tokens.usage: Width of the building sprite on an opened window, centred on its frame's top edge.

tokens.name: banner-h
tokens.usage: Height of the window building sprite (2:1).

tokens.name: road-tile
tokens.usage: Camp road tile (top-down); the dirt track is 8px wide through its middle.

tokens.name: cart
tokens.usage: Width of the mine cart sprite (20×18, side profile, symmetric). Its wheels sit 2px above the bottom edge of the road track.

tokens.name: doodad-s
tokens.usage: Camp map decoration, small: a tree (at most 16×24) or a bush (16×12). 5–7 decorations per screen in all.

tokens.name: doodad-l
tokens.usage: Camp map decoration, large: an icy mountain or a rock (at most 32×24).

tokens.name: icon-command
tokens.usage: Camp command-button icon inside a 40px bevelled button.

tokens.name: icon-resource
tokens.usage: Camp HUD resource icon (gold, lumber, meat, quota) and cart sprite.

tokens.name: ork-w
tokens.usage: Width of the ork sprite (orks/ork.png: the ork mark's head on its 12×8 grid at 2×, its state drawn inside it) that replaces 🧌 in badges, the roster and the War Map, with ork-h.

tokens.name: ork-h
tokens.usage: Height of the ork sprite. It sits inside the badge plate, title bars included.

tokens.name: portrait-w
tokens.usage: Ork portrait width (Warcraft 2 portrait proportions), with portrait-h.

tokens.name: portrait-h
tokens.usage: Ork portrait height.

tokens.name: bevel-raised
tokens.usage: Raised camp faces (buttons, title bars, HUD). Office: flat.

tokens.name: bevel-sunken
tokens.usage: Sunken wells (inputs, logs, pressed buttons). Office: a 1px inset hairline.

tokens.name: shadow-window
tokens.usage: Windows and dialogs over the canvas. Camp: a hard keyline and a 4px drop, no blur (sprite look). Office: a soft editor-widget shadow.

tokens.name: glow-fire
tokens.usage: Halo round a burning building (camp) or the red outline of a waiting one (office).

meta.note: Camp keeps the TUI's hex values where they exist (forest frames are now bronze and gold at the user's direction); Office keeps VS Code's layout but takes Camp's palette, calmer: warm dark browns, gold accents and moss green, so both looks read as one product. Sprite sizes and the ground are new for the GUI.
